principles: Must-always-run covers repository/build/unit/deterministic authoritative contracts plus the current checkpoint's 72-variant operational sensor/acquisition/EW study.
Deep Calibration remains opt-in unless a checkpoint changes mechanics that require historical stochastic requalification.
The accepted Checkpoint 62 108-variant power-doctrine/reactor study and Checkpoint 61 54-variant composed-build study move to Deep Calibration as historical stochastic regression evidence.
Production TL1 reactor output remains 5 Tactical Power and FullVolleyFirst is used for the current offensive-isolation study so power starvation does not confound sensor value.
All cruisers retain core passive/navigation sensing; the optional 3-Space Active Sensor suite extends the operational Firm/Approximate envelope and can consume Tactical Power.
Side B retains an established Firm solution in the current matrix so only Side A acquisition consequences change.
The one-point EW lane is an abstract net range-pressure stress input, not a valuation or pricing decision for a particular ECM/ECCM installation.
Simulation diagnoses consequences; it does not manufacture fixed build or weapon-family win percentages.
Latent/contextual advantages remain valid design value even when the current opponent does not exercise them; Energy APEN is the explicit standing example.
Generated historical checkpoint text logs/manifests/readmes remain excluded from full-repository packaging unless active tooling explicitly consumes them.

notes.reasonDeepCalibrationNotRequired: The operational track fields default to EstablishedFirm and therefore preserve historical study behavior; the current normal suite directly exercises the new sensor/acquisition path.
